sources: Grapevine Menus XML.gvm and met-mechanics.csv (tools/catalog/source/) as seeded into wp_be_schema_blocks, dumped by tools/catalog/dump_live.sh
Laws of the Resurrection (WW05035) p. 64 - a beginning Amenti assigns Balance 1, Willpower 5, Sekhem 1 ("which, like any starting Amenti, begins with one Trait")

Laws of the Resurrection (WW05035) p. 67 - Free Traits alone cannot raise Balance above 3 or Sekhem above the character's own Balance rating, not encoded as a structural cap here (matching this project's existing precedent of leaving a rating-tied ceiling flat, e.g. Vampire's Blood against Generation)
Laws of the Resurrection (WW05035) p. 67 - a maximum of 10 permanent Willpower Traits; p. 94-95 - Balance never exceeds 5 ("even if the new Balance rating is less than five")
Laws of the Resurrection (WW05035) p. 115 - new Willpower 3 XP/Trait, new Sekhem 3 XP/Trait, new Balance a number of Experience Traits equal to the level desired
